content.short: Defi Cattos is a P2E battle RPG on the Aptos blockchain featuring "tap-to-airdrop" mechanics and NFT pets.
content.description: Defi Cattos is a play-to-earn (P2E) gaming ecosystem built on the Aptos blockchain, centered around collectible NFT cat pets and competitive battle mechanics. The project features an innovative "tap-to-airdrop" game where users can earn rewards through active engagement and social interaction. Beyond its gaming elements, Defi Cattos aims to build a robust community-driven platform that integrates social finance with decentralized gaming. By leveraging Aptos's high performance and the growing popularity of gamified rewards, Defi Cattos provides a fun and accessible entry point for users to explore the broader Web3 ecosystem through interactive digital ownership.
